description: This bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of instilled preferences for two language models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, comparing performance across three conditions: a control group (gray bars), models before introspection training (light blue bars), and models after introspection training (dark purple bars). The vertical axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences),” ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 in increments of 0.25, representing the correlation between the model’s reported preference weights and the actual weights that guided its decisions. The horizontal axis presents the two model types, GPT-4o on the left and GPT-4o-mini on the right. For each model, the control bar (gray) is the shortest, with a value near 0.20 for GPT-4o and near 0.00 for GPT-4o-mini. The “Before Introspection Training” bar (light blue) is taller, with a value of approximately 0.55 for GPT-4o and approximately 0.50 for GPT-4o-mini. The “After Introspection Training” bar (dark purple) is the tallest for both models, with values of approximately 0.75 for GPT-4o and approximately 0.75 for GPT-4o-mini. Error bars, representing 95% Highest Density Intervals, are present for each bar, indicating the uncertainty around the reported accuracy values. The chart visually demonstrates that introspection training significantly improves the models’ ability to accurately report their instilled preferences, as evidenced by the substantial increase in bar height from the control condition to the post-training condition for both models.
